description: This file contains unit tests for the DeviceVideoCapabilities class and its derived test classes. It sets up mocks for dependencies like host, manager, and video port objects, and verifies various methods related to supported video displays, EDID, default resolutions, supported resolutions, and HDCP support. It uses Google Test framework to organize and run the tests.

classes.name: DeviceVideoCapabilitiesTest
classes.description: Base test fixture class for DeviceVideoCapabilities, initializes mocks for core components and provides setup and teardown routines.

classes.name: DeviceVideoCapabilitiesDsTest
classes.description: Derived test fixture class that further mocks device-specific components such as host and video output ports, used for detailed functional tests.

methods.name: SupportedVideoDisplays
methods.description: Tests retrieving the list of supported video display outputs like HDMI ports.

methods.name: HostEDID
methods.description: Tests reading the EDID data from the host and encoding it in base64.

methods.name: DefaultResolution_noParam
methods.description: Tests obtaining the default resolution for a given output port without specifying a particular port.

methods.name: SupportedResolutions_noParam
methods.description: Tests enumerating supported resolutions for the current video output port.

methods.name: SupportedHdcp_noParam
methods.description: Tests support for HDCP copy protection protocols.

methods.name: SupportedVideoDisplays_exception
methods.description: Tests error handling when fetching video display outputs (simulates exception).

methods.name: HostEDID_exception
methods.description: Tests error handling when reading EDID (simulates exception).

methods.name: DefaultResolution_HDMI0_exception
methods.description: Tests error handling when fetching default resolution for HDMI port (simulates exception).

methods.name: SupportedResolutions_HDMI0_exception
methods.description: Tests error handling when fetching supported resolutions for HDMI port (simulates exception).

methods.name: SupportedHdcp_HDMI0_exception
methods.description: Tests error handling when fetching HDCP protocol support for HDMI port (simulates exception).
